faqs.q: How long does a website project take?
faqs.a: Most studio web builds take between 3 to 5 weeks from initial discovery to final deployment, depending on custom CMS requirements and the scope of pages.

faqs.q: Do you use templates or build custom?
faqs.a: Every single line of layout, styling, and code is designed and built from scratch specifically for your brand. We do not use pre-purchased templates.

faqs.q: Can our team update content after launch?
faqs.a: Yes. For dynamic sites, we build dedicated lightweight admin portals where your team can add products, update copy, and publish new collections without touching code.

faqs.q: Will the website be fast on mobile?
faqs.a: Yes. We target 90+ Lighthouse performance scores, optimizing all assets to modern WebP formats and keeping frontend scripts lightweight for instant loading.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
faqs.a: Standard business card runs start at 200 units per name. For specialty packaging or custom rigid boxes, MOQs typically start between 50 to 100 units.

faqs.q: What paper thickness do you recommend?
faqs.a: For executive business cards, we recommend 400 GSM soft-touch matte or 600 GSM multi-layer cotton stock for a distinctive, weighty hand-feel.

faqs.q: Do you provide print-ready source files?
faqs.a: Yes. You receive press-ready vector PDFs with embedded fonts, 3mm bleeds, CMYK color profiles, and dedicated spot UV/foil separation vector layers.

faqs.q: Can you handle the printing and physical shipping?
faqs.a: Yes. We manage the entire production lifecycle with our certified pre-press print partners and deliver finished materials directly to your office across India.
